pages.title: Sense Studios | Work Management
pages.text:
Skip to main content
Sense Studios
Your work, on your phone

Employees, site workers and the Owner use the same app. Your own account controls what you can see and do.

Android
Open this address in Chrome.
Open the browser menu and choose Install app or Add to Home screen.
Open Sense Studios from your home screen, then sign in with your own passkey.
iPhone
Open this address in Safari.
Choose Share → Add to Home Screen. Enable Open as Web App if shown, then tap Add.
Open the new icon and sign in. If you cannot sign in, ask the Owner for account recovery.
Before going to a site

While online, open your assigned site and prepare its offline capture context. Supported notes, new photos, report drafts, snags and progress can be saved locally. Reopen the app online to synchronize and resolve any conflicts.

Check that captures show Synchronized before clearing browser storage, reinstalling or changing phones. Pending captures exist only on this device. Approvals and other unsupported actions need an online connection.

Keep access secure

Use your own account and a phone screen lock. Report a lost phone to the Owner promptly. Launch alerts are available in the app and by configured email; installation alone does not enable lock-screen notifications.

Open Sense Studios
